about: Script builtins the PS4 T7 eboot links (GSC linker sub_76EE50 through sub_AA79C0 gsc functions, sub_AA7BF0 gsc methods, sub_6C0E20 csc functions, sub_6C12E0 csc methods): canonical name hash -> [min args, max args]. pc_only: builtins the PC build adds (PC tables minus these), with the PS4 builtin a call is rewritten to when one gives the same result on PC (ps4, and why).

8b57c052.name: modvar
8b57c052.why: PC only runs it while a mod is loaded (it never touches engine dvars), so in a usermap it does nothing; array() takes the same arguments and has no effect
